hypothesis: The existing three-block reversal rule can be evaluated with exactly observed block-opening and block-closing prices. Removing the unnecessary 225-consecutive-minute availability requirement could retain its improvement in net return per trade at a useful sample size.
baseline: Unmodified Patrick K10 small_pullback at JST 08:15, exact 08:00..08:14 M1 and current fill-open as before. Additional attribution control uses the same six required endpoint bars as the candidate but accepts either direction.
data_manifest: agent_runs/patrick_h4_7d_reverse_20261107/result.json manifest, verify 32 Bars.dat/info.dat digests. Missing minutes are never filled or substituted.
entry_timeframe: M1 chronological replay; 08:00 JST decision, exact 08:15 fill on JST weekdays.
higher_timeframe_rules: Same completed H4 and completed UTC weekly 70% value areas as control.
entry_rules: Keep all small_pullback and K10 eligibility rules. At fill require actual M1 timestamps at offsets -225,-151,-150,-76,-75,-1 minutes from 08:15. Use first open and final close of each 75-minute block respectively. If three moves are strictly negative, positive, positive allow buy; positive, negative, negative allow sell. Equal moves or any absent endpoint reject the pattern. No other missingness gate outside the baseline's own requirements. Independent stateful replay for base, six-observation control, and candidate. No same-decision substitution after rejection.

exit_rules.reward_risk_ratio: Variable reverse-swap TP/SL; original three-calendar-day / Friday 20:00 UTC expiry, gaps and stop-first intrabar ordering.

periods.additional_diagnostic: 2026-01-05 inclusive, 2026-08-28 exclusive UTC. Engine runs continuously; M1 history from 2009-10-01 through 2026-08-31 exclusive.

final_period_prior_exposure: All periods previously inspected. The original strict 225-minute reversal performance and endpoint coverage concerns were known before freezing. New candidate P/L not inspected. Available history cannot establish prospective success.
search_space: Only the availability requirement changes from the previously studied three-block reversal. No alteration of sign sequence, entry/exit, tolerance, or pair list. For complete windows, verify the relaxed signal and the original signal agree independently of later strategy state.
cost_and_fill_model: Original fixed 1/2-pip spread, 0.1/0.2-pip slippage per side, elapsed-day carry 0.2/1 pip (normal/stress), cost gate includes three days of carry. M1 OHLC assumed Bid, original unchanged fill and stop/take-profit treatment.
position_sizing_and_currency: 100 units capital per symbol, 1% of current per-symbol equity risked per modeled R; pooled PF, mean and total measured on net R per closed trade.
acceptance_gates: In each of all 6 historical (3 era x 2 cost) cells: >=30 closed candidate trades, >=6 active pairs, PF_R>1, mean net R>0, and strict improvement in PF_R, win rate and mean net R over both the unfiltered baseline and the six-observation control. If any cell fails, reject robust improvement and stop. The same conditions in both 2026 cells are required for any stronger corroboration; no prospective adoption based on reused history. Report total R separately as a frequency check.
cross_symbol_rule: All 16 FX pairs, no pair selection; report active pairs, counts and per-symbol results. Per-pair realized drawdown as in reference metrics.
